title: antfly-grep opt-in workspace result batch v3
$comment: Register with compact=true,batches=true. No changes to CLI v1/v2. Only match/context events for the currently open file are batched, with at most 32768 bytes of encoded event body; first row and oversized rows stream individually. Consumers keep original batch bytes and expand only at materialization. A successful complete summary/workspace_end is required before committing a view. Errors, cancellation and response budgets invalidate the transaction. This is a private workspace protocol, not ripgrep JSON.
